record.paper_title: Research Problems in Function Theory (New Edition)
record.original_question: Does there exist a bounded analytic function in D such that the image of every radius has infinite length? See, for example, Anderson [21], and Rudin [682]. (W. Rudin; communicated by K. F. Barth)

evidence.quote: Does there exist a bounded analytic function in D such that the image of every radius has infinite length? See, for example, Anderson [21], and Rudin [682]. (W. Rudin; communicated by K. F. Barth)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ denote the open unit disc. For $\theta\in[0,2\pi)$, the radius at angle $\theta$ is the segment $R_\theta=\{re^{i\theta}:0\le r<1\}$. Given an analytic function $f:\mathbb{D}\to\mathbb{C}$, the (Euclidean) length of the image $f(R_\theta)$ is
$$L(\theta;f)=\int_0^1 |f'(re^{i\theta})|\,dr.$$
Does there exist a bounded analytic function $f:\mathbb{D}\to\mathbb{C}$ (i.e. $\sup_{z\in\mathbb{D}}|f(z)|<\infty$) such that $L(\theta;f)=\infty$ for every $\theta\in[0,2\pi)$?
artifact.category_tag: bounded analytic functions on the unit disc
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches turn up related results on bounded analytic functions with level sets of infinite length (e.g., a 1982 Proceedings of the AMS paper, and work by Piranian–Weitsman, Hayman–Wu), but no source clearly resolves the specific question of whether a bounded analytic function can have the image of every radius of infinite Euclidean length. The current status from the searches is inconclusive.

status_evidence.title: A bounded analytic function in the unit disk (Proc. AMS, 1982)
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of a bounded analytic function in the unit disk with prescribed level-set / boundary-length properties.
status_evidence.claim: Related constructions of bounded analytic functions in the disc with infinite-length curves exist, but address level sets rather than radii.

status_evidence.title: Measures induced by analytic functions and a problem of Walter Rudin
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses problems of Rudin concerning bounded analytic functions on the disc.
status_evidence.claim: Rudin posed several questions about bounded analytic functions on the disc; this particular radius-length question is not addressed in accessible sources.
